name: Space Syrup
source:
Join Rhea Ramirez as she starts her internship at Space Syrup, an agency that helps out any planet in need. As the pressure of leadership sets in, it’s up to you to decide if Rhea can succeed! Battle a killer kaiju with your sense of fashion, find potential love with other interns, and even pet a frog in this unique adventure.

[From [url=https://julescalypso.itch.io/space-syrup]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
跟隨瑞婭．拉米雷斯，在為各個有需要的星球提供幫助的Space Syrup機構開始實習。隨著領導團隊的壓力逐漸襲來，瑞婭能否成功，就由你來決定！在這場獨特冒險中，用你的時尚品味對抗致命怪獸，與其他實習生尋找愛情，甚至還能摸摸青蛙。

[摘自[url=https://julescalypso.itch.io/space-syrup]itch.io[/url]]
